test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54e00f6add1faa2d976b30796a3e6eab26bee48d110f7d9c209df7c9d8f04b9e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The symbol 'Square' has shaded alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d61c856597c42b5ec995bd291b6beffe1a0f579fe85596a28ab1df4c169f1b7e.png] 

Step II: The symbol 'Triangle' is getting rotated 90 degree in anticlockwise direction and shifted one place in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a00e18192533e23d154d29ede1b156ce35c2f945c97f4fa1b70b04d95bc0dc0d.png] 

Step III: The symbol 'Hexagon' is getting shifted one place in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c586996ad466975f7e99fb83c66135462ce060efebc766dec62a6198432b656f.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33e19cc248993bbf91ba3570c82f97eb4763930d7c27d7012238100ba7938885.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
